retrievalProfile.description: A close-up, desaturated portrait of a man looking down, featuring a vertical Japanese-style obi strip on the left and clean serif typography at the top.
triggerTerms: music CD layout with obi strip
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif minimalist layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, angled close-up of a man with a beard and cap, looking downward in a contemplative pose. The image uses a muted, warm-grey color palette with high texture in the clothing. A dark vertical banner containing vertical text sits on the far left edge, while the main artist and title text are positioned in the upper left quadrant over a light background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's downward gaze creates a diagonal line from top right to bottom center
Vertical obi strip balances the horizontal text alignment
High-texture fabric in the foreground contrasts with the smooth skin tones
Light background in the upper left provides a canvas for dark typography
coreInvariants: Tight cropping focusing on the face and shoulder
Presence of a vertical sidebar for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a tight head-and-shoulders shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and brow area, despite being cast in shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dark obi strip on the left, moves to the artist name, then follows the subject's gaze down towards the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left corner to allow for legible typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted taupe and warm grey (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, leaning towards mid-tones and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Open counters in the display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic serif pairing using weight and scale for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical sidebar (Obi strip) on the left edge
Horizontal divider lines within the sidebar

preserve: Wide tracking for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical Roman all-caps serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and elegant serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a bearded man wearing a dark cap and a textured grey jacket over a white ribbed shirt. The man should be looking down and to the right. Apply a desaturated, warm-grey filter. Leave the top-left corner relatively clear and light. Add a dark vertical strip on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, wide-tracked all-caps serif font in the top left. Place the album title in a smaller, lighter all-caps serif font directly below it. Add vertical Japanese-style characters and small metadata text inside the dark left sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the main text in an all-caps serif font?
Is the color palette desaturated and warm-toned?
Is there a vertical dark strip on the left edge?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left obi strip
Tracking width of the display typography
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Do not replicate the exact Japanese text content
Ensure the portrait is a generic representation of the style

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between the sidebar and the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is left-aligned and does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the vertical sidebar contains vertical text elements.
Ensure the overall mood is somber and contemplative.
Confirm the color palette remains within the warm-grey/taupe range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject (Angled/Downcast) + Desaturated Warm Palette + Top-Left Serif Typography + Left-Edge Vertical Sidebar = Melancholic Album Aesthetic
